scope: Advice Articles and their page-local Sections and article-specific Actions. Home, campaigns, and their shared CampaignAction template remain outside this workflow. Existing approved content is initialized once through the CMS and never serialized as authored workflow state.
types: Native ValidatorsAction, Datasource Workflow Action (ApplyForDataSourceItemsAction), and PublishAction; no custom code or SPE
nativeWriteStatus: Applied and read back through Sitecore Authoring API on 2026-11-14. Page and datasource transitions, return/resubmit, history comments, draft/review 404, and automatic publication after approval verified on owned disposable articles.
targetResolution: Native publishing target Edge maps to database experienceedge. Current PublishAction resolves explicit targets as database names.

datasourceWorkflow.defaults: Site-specific Settings/Standard Values/Datasources for Section and Article action, with _PerSiteStandardValues inheritance.
datasourceWorkflow.coordination: Native Datasource Workflow Action on each page command, scope Descendants; only the article-local content workflow accepts those commands.

articleAction.reason: Independent native template lets article Actions follow approval without enrolling Home/campaign Action content.
